definitions.zeroNetworkCore: Core has no ambient local-network or internet entitlement and cannot open sockets or invoke arbitrary URLs.
definitions.gatewayOnlyEgress: The Gateway is the only local process permitted to open local-network or internet sockets.
definitions.localCanonicalData: Local identity, keys, policy, memory, and canonical user data remain authoritative.
definitions.firstPartyCloud: First-party cloud plaintext processing is permitted only in an approved attested confidential-compute workload; there is no non-attested first-party fallback.
definitions.userControlledDestinations: BYO providers and self-hosted nodes are distinct user-selected destinations governed by their own disclosure and trust policies.
definitions.historicalState: SEMBLANCE_STATE.md and historical payment/session records are read-only migration evidence, never current release state.
